name: @minibook/host-android
description: MiniBook Android standalone host (Capacitor 8, appId dev.minibook.app, Books): bounded native fs.read, Media3 ReadAloudService, and E-Ink detector/refresh/hardware-key bridge.

scripts.cap:sync: pnpm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: node ../../scripts/bump-version.mjs && pnpm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:apk:ci: pnpm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
